Guided Demo Mode

Run a staged walkthrough for client demonstrations. Each step pauses until you continue.

BeAccessible Walkthrough

Walkthrough steps

  1. Show learner progress and active tasks.
  2. Submit evidence for a pending task.
  3. Switch to mentor review and approve submission.
  4. Open admin analytics and show dashboard updates.
  5. Open notifications to show audit trail and system prompts.
